rating: Stars combine the kind of newsroom (public broadcaster or news agency 5, newspaper or business daily 4, broadcaster or digital site 3.5, tabloid or state-controlled 2.5) with its reach in the country (top 3 +0.5, ranks 8-10 -0.25). State-controlled outlets are labelled as such.
